tool_config.name: create_task
tool_config.description: Create a seat-hold task for the caller. Returns task_id, pin, and board_url. Call it only after the caller has said yes to a summary of all four values: the task, the place, the time limit, and the price.

request_body_schema.description: The seat-hold task that the caller confirmed.

description.description: The task in a few words, without the place, the time, or the price. Example: Save one seat.

place.description: Where to save the seat, in the caller's words. Example: the front table.

time_limit_minutes.description: How many minutes from now the seat must be saved, as a whole number that the caller said. Example: 10.

price_usd.description: The maximum price in US dollars that the caller said. Never guess this value. Example: 5.
